archetype: Archetype 3 (Pastel & Soft) mixed with Archetype 1 (Organic & Earthy)
emotional_tone: Celebratory, elegant, effortless, and premium. Usable for both formal weddings and casual birthdays.

typography.guidelines: Headings must use Playfair Display for a tasteful, premium feel. Body text uses Manrope for maximum legibility. Use tighter letter spacing for large headers.

layout_and_spacing.cards: Generous padding (24px). Border radius 20px or 24px for a soft, modern look. Soft drop shadows.
layout_and_spacing.editor_canvas: Centered, flex-1, taking up maximum available height above the bottom sheet toolbar. Should include a subtle border or card-like appearance.
layout_and_spacing.bottom_sheet: Border top radius of 24px, pure white background, strong top shadow, with a small drag indicator pill at the top center.
layout_and_spacing.general: Prioritize negative space. Never cram elements. Mobile-first layout emphasizing thumb reachability for primary actions.

motion_and_interactions.transitions: Use LayoutAnimation or React Native Reanimated for smooth transitions when switching categories or opening the editor.
motion_and_interactions.buttons: Apply activeOpacity={0.7} on TouchableOpacity elements to provide tactile feedback.
motion_and_interactions.editor_elements: Allow basic dragging and scaling gestures if using a library, otherwise fixed center alignment with nice fade-in animation.

testing_attributes.rule: All interactive and key informational elements MUST include a data-testid attribute.

components.TemplateCard: ImageBackground with a dark gradient overlay at the bottom for text legibility. Title positioned bottom-left in Playfair Display.
components.CategoryPill: Horizontal ScrollView. Active state uses primary color background with white text, inactive uses surface color with text_primary.
components.BottomToolbar: Contains touchable icon buttons for 'Text', 'Background', 'Color', and 'AI Suggest'. Align icons evenly in a row.
components.EditorCanvas: A designated View acting as the invite boundary. Contains an Image layer and absolute positioned Text layers that can be edited.

instructions_to_main_agent: You are building a React Native Expo application. Produce .js files.
Do NOT use HTML/web components. Use standard React Native components: View, Text, ScrollView, TouchableOpacity, Image, ImageBackground, StyleSheet.
Use expo-sharing for the save/share functionality.
Use expo-image-picker for the 'import from device gallery' functionality.
Integrate the FastAPI backend solely for AI text suggestion endpoints.
Implement the UI directly using StyleSheet with the defined hex colors and spacing guidelines, or NativeWind if configured in the Expo setup.
Ensure the layout is responsive for mobile dimensions (no fixed absolute widths where flex or percentages fit better).
Ensure all user-interactable and visual distinct elements include `data-testid` properties (e.g., testID='save-invite-btn' for React Native).
